hard_invariants: CURRENT_ONLY requires no adapted context and zero injections.
SEPARATE_VERIFIED_CONTEXT_V1 requires a compliant adapter and non-null verified context.
The original task occurs exactly once and is never concatenated with context.
Unknown or false backend capability blocks context-enabled spawn.
Any final integrity, permission, or budget failure blocks child spawn.
Context is not written to .agents/skills or AGENTS files.
Missing or unknown values are not converted to PASS.

the existing v1 current path is independently safe and READY or safe NO_ACTION
the user did not explicitly require adapted or external expert capability

the cause is availability, no approved match, or optional materialization failure
the cause is not security, permission, integrity, provenance, or source ambiguity
the degraded result is explicitly recorded and reported
